# MCP tools

> **Generated, do not edit.** This page is produced by `python tools/gen_tool_ref.py` from the tools the atlas-mcp server registers with FastMCP, read back the way an MCP client's `tools/list` sees them. To change a tool, change `mcp/app/` (descriptions live in `mcp/app/descriptions.py`) and regenerate.

For how an agent connects to Atlas and the conventions it is expected to follow, see [Agents](guides/agents.md). This page is the reference: each tool's name, the description the server sends, and its input schema.

Every tool returns the same envelope: `{"ok": true, "result": ...}` on success, `{"ok": false, "error": {"type": ..., "message": ...}}` on failure. A description ending in *More: tools guide.* points to the detailed tools guide, which an agent reads with `atlas_doc_read` (see that tool).

In the tables, *omitted* means the parameter has no default in the schema: leaving it out is not the same as passing `null` (for example, `null` clears a field, leaving it out leaves the field alone).

27 tools.

- [Read](#read): `atlas_health`, `atlas_outline`, `atlas_context`, `atlas_node_search`, `atlas_search`, `atlas_structure`, `atlas_get`, `atlas_tree`, `atlas_path`, `atlas_intents`, `atlas_doc_read`, `atlas_adr_search`, `atlas_adr_get`, `atlas_capabilities`
- [Work](#work): `atlas_file_work`, `atlas_update_work`
- [Graph writes](#graph-writes): `atlas_node_write`, `atlas_edge_write`, `atlas_edge_delete`, `atlas_doc_write`, `atlas_intent_write`, `atlas_intent_delete`, `atlas_delete`
- [Comments](#comments): `atlas_comments`, `atlas_comment_write`
- [The first-run setup guide](#the-first-run-setup-guide): `atlas_setup_guide`
- [Session](#session): `atlas_save_work`

## Read

### `atlas_health`

Is atlas-api up? Returns node and edge counts as a plausibility check.

No parameters.

### `atlas_outline`

The contains tree as indented text, one line per node: what exists. Defaults to the world (families=object,bridge); scope with root=, add names=true. More: tools guide.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `root` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `families` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `max_depth` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
| `names` | boolean \| null | no | `null` |

### `atlas_context`

Tell me about X, in one call: the best-matching nodes, their neighbours, what depends on them, the intents that apply, related decisions and docs to read next. Pointers within budgets; each part says when it was cut. Ask in your own words, Swedish works. Start here for an open question. More: tools guide.

| `impact` | integer \| null | no | `null` |

| `intents_full` | boolean \| null | no | `null` |
| `decisions` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
| `docs` | integer \| null | no | `null` |

### `atlas_node_search`

Which world node knows about X? Semantic + full-text search (mode="hybrid", the default) over names, prose and served docs: ask in your own words or in Swedish, or give an exact name. Returns pointers (id, summary, snippet), not content. mode="fulltext" for word matching only; expand=true adds graph neighbours. More: tools guide.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | string | yes |  |
| `families` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `page` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
| `page_size` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
| `mode` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `expand` | boolean \| null | no | `null` |

This deployment's legal node types, edge types, statuses, workitem types and intent kinds, and this server's tool list. About 25 KB. More: tools guide.

## Work

### `atlas_file_work`

Create a workitem (a type atlas_capabilities lists) with its acceptance, parent, binding, depends_on, priority (low|medium|high|critical) and labels in one transaction. A task's id is minted; an epic or story needs a slug id. `body` is the spec, never a result. Suggest a binding, do not guess one. Decisions are raised with a dedicated tool, not here. More: tools guide.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `id` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `parent` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `binding` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `body` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `acceptance` | array of string \| null | no | `null` |
| `depends_on` | array of string \| null | no | `null` |
| `status` | string | no | `"pending"` |
| `priority` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `labels` | array of string \| null | no | `null` |

### `atlas_update_work`

Update a workitem. status, result, priority, labels and parent (moves it) are plain (null clears, omitted leaves). body, acceptance, depends_on and binding REPLACE WHOLESALE and need set_\<field>=True. Returns the prior values. Acceptance needs a person: propose_acceptance=True (approved on the board), or approval={by,quote} where the install allows attested writes. More: tools guide.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `status` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `result` | string \| null | no | *omitted* |
| `body` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `set_body` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `acceptance` | array of string \| null | no | `null` |
| `set_acceptance` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `depends_on` | array of string \| null | no | `null` |
| `set_depends_on` | boolean | no | `false` |
| `binding` | string \| null | no | `null` |

| `approval` | object \| null | no | `null` |

| `proposal_note` | string \| null | no | `null` |

| `parent` | string \| null | no | *omitted* |

## Graph writes

### `atlas_node_write`

Create a node (needs type and name) or patch the fields given. `attributes` merge by default; attributes_mode="replace" overwrites them. key= sets a project's task-id prefix. More: tools guide.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `name` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `summary` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `abstract` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `detail` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `owner` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `source` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `attributes` | object \| null | no | `null` |
| `attributes_mode` | string | no | `"merge"` |
| `key` | string \| null | no | *omitted* |

### `atlas_edge_write`

Create one edge between two existing nodes. Not for nesting workitems: that is atlas_file_work. More: tools guide.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | yes |  |
| `dst` | string | yes |  |
| `edge_type` | string | yes |  |
| `directed` | boolean | no | `true` |

|---|---|---|---|

### `atlas_delete`

> Offered only when `ATLAS_MCP_ENABLE_DELETE` is set on atlas-mcp. Off by default; the caller also needs the `admin` scope.

PERMANENT delete of a node, edge, doc or intent: no undo. A node delete cascades and needs expected_edge_count; call once without it and the refusal gives it. More: tools guide.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | yes |  |
| `node_id` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `edge_id` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
| `path` | string \| null | no | `null` |
| `intent_id` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
| `expected_edge_count` | integer \| null | no | `null` |
